What is inside

Everything in its place

A familiar shell, familiar programs and the disk layout you expect.

Centered taskbar and modern Start

Start and your running apps sit in the middle, with the notification area on the right. Pinned grid, recommendations and search in one panel.

File Explorer

Ribbon, Quick access, This PC. It is explorer.exe.

Light and dark

Fluent-style icons and colors that follow the system theme.

Same layout on disk

Windows, Program Files, ProgramData, Users.

Open source

Built from the LakoOS and ReactOS code under the GNU GPL.

Two Start styles

Centered grid, or the left-aligned list with tiles. Switch with one setting.

    Questions

    Is LakoOS Windows?

    No. LakoOS is an independent, free operating system built on the NT architecture. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. It follows the Windows folder layout and file names so people and programs feel at home.

    Will my Windows programs run?

    Many Win32 programs run and compatibility keeps improving. This is a development preview, so expect gaps, especially with the newest applications.

    Can I use it every day?

    Not yet. Try it in a virtual machine and report what breaks in GitHub Issues.

    How do I switch the Start style?

    Set ShellStyle to 10 or 11 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced, and TaskbarAl to 0 or 1 for taskbar alignment. It applies the next time you open Start.

    Where does the code come from?

    LakoOS is a fork of LakoOS, which is a fork of ReactOS. The original authors are credited in the repository and the GPL notices are kept.
